news.title: Spielman installed as Lauren and Lee Fixel Distinguished Professor
news.summary_en: Economist David Spielman brings global expertise in food policy and agricultural innovation to Bursky Public Health, advancing research connecting food systems and health.

news.title: Using AI to fight election misinformation works, WashU research finds
news.summary_en: Artificial intelligence could help counter election misinformation at the same speed that false narratives spread, according to new research from WashU and Caltech.

news.title: ‘The opportunity to engage’
news.summary_en: WashU Arts & Sciences will host its second annual Teaching Innovation Showcase Oct. 22. In this Q&A, three participating faculty — Michael Olson, B. Duygu Özpolat and Zhiling Zheng — discuss their projects and teaching philosophies.

news.title: Wick installed as Robert G. and Maxine W. Scheibe Professor of Mathematics
news.summary_en: Brett D. Wick, chair of the Department of Mathematics in Arts & Sciences, has been installed as the inaugural Robert G. and Maxine W. Scheibe Professor of Mathematics.

news.title: In the clouds
news.summary_en: Under a new grant from the NSF, a WashU team will use AI and statistics to study the impact of aerosols on marine low clouds. That knowledge can help communities protect health and prepare for extreme weather.
